turns.message: I am planning for a June 1, 2027 wedding. My shopping budget is $1,800 total. I like classic, comfortable ivory accessories. I already bought my dress. Please remember my budget, style, and remaining shopping categories.
Create a prioritized shopping checklist for what I still need. Include target dates and estimated ranges, and exclude my dress because I already bought it.
Search for comfortable ivory wedding shoes under $150. Compare the options against my preferences and do not recommend satin.
I choose the pearl detail ivory flat, product shoe-002 from the search results. Save that as my selected shoe.
This is a new planning session. What total budget and shoe choice did I ask you to remember?
Update my remaining shopping plan using my saved decisions and purchased items.
I am tempted by an extra $2,500 accessory. That conflicts with my saved total budget; flag the conflict and do not change the budget unless I explicitly confirm a revision.
Find one current pearl hair accessory option and compare it with my saved style and budget. Keep my selected shoes and budget unchanged.
